scope: Read-only review of the NetCDF branch WrfType adapter and extracted public-wrapper test; no compile, test execution, model, or raw scientific data access.

review.wrapper_signature: The extracted wrf_get_var_info retains its public eight-argument signature. Its NETCDF branch passes NetCDFFieldType as argument eight and Status as argument nine to ext_ncd_get_var_info, matching the backend declaration. Other backend branches and the public API are unchanged.
review.wrapper_fixture: The Python runner extracts the actual dim_from_memorder, lower_case, and wrf_get_var_info bodies from module_io.F. It links the actual ext_ncd_get_var_info backend from wrf_io.F90; only WRF state/routing/monitor dependencies are stubbed. The fixture explicitly traps an unexpected quilt-path call.
coverage: The main test opens a real backend NetCDF read handle and invokes check_varinfo_buffers while that handle is live.
A padded output buffer verifies successful wrapper dispatch and returned rank/order/domain end.
A missing-variable call checks that the public Status returns the NetCDF backend error, rather than the backend WrfType value overwriting Status.
A one-character output buffer is checked through both the backend and public wrapper; the wrapper must return WRF_WARN_CHARSTR_GT_LENDATA with NDim reset to zero and the short order buffer blanked.
Malformed MemoryOrder attribute rejection is tested directly against the backend; it is not represented as a public-wrapper test.
review.source_safety: The backend initializes NDim and MemoryOrder before handle/attribute checks. It reads the MemoryOrder attribute into a fixed three-character temporary only after checking the NetCDF attribute length, then rejects a caller buffer shorter than the stored nonblank value before assignment. The fixture's padded and short-buffer expectations align with that order of operations.
remaining_scope_limits: This is an extracted-wrapper fixture, not a full module_io build/runtime. The handle mapping, io_form selection, monitor predicate, and quilt implementation are replaced by deterministic stubs.

The public wrapper has other backends whose dummy counts differ. This change only repairs and tests the NETCDF branch; it does not establish or repair the PHDF5, NETCDFPAR, PNETCDF, PIO, ADIOS2, GRIB2, GRIB1, or INT/ESMF paths.
No execution result is claimed by this review.
